name: The Strongest Battlegrounds
desc:
Train & fight others to be the strongest.

📱💻🎮 You can play on any device. (CONSOLE, PC, MOBILE)
⭐ Please consider liking and favoriting the game for more updates.

🖥️ Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Q (while ragdolled) - ragdoll cancel/evasive
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel

🏆 "Best Fighting Experience" Innovation Awards '24

This game includes randomized rewards (emotes and spins). All items have an equal chance of being obtained. No duplicates are possible.
